Package com.nexuslink.core.config

Class SettingsService

java.lang.Object
com.nexuslink.core.config.SettingsService
public final class SettingsService extends Object
App-facing settings layer over ApplicationConfig. It exposes a small, documented set of named, typed preferences with sensible defaults and a lightweight change-notification mechanism so UI (or any other component) can react when a setting changes — without pulling in an event bus or any external dependency.

Every setter writes through to the backing ApplicationConfig (which persists eagerly) and then fires the registered listeners with the changed key's name.
